audience: support and operations teams that send SMS alerts and place calls through Plivo

useCases.title: Find out why a text message failed
useCases.text: List the recent SMS and MMS records, then open one to read its state and error code.

useCases.title: Review live and queued calls
useCases.text: List the calls that are live or queued, then open one to read its status, direction, numbers and billing.

useCases.title: Check the account and its credits
useCases.text: Read the account type, billing mode and remaining cash credits in USD. Run it first to confirm the connection.

useCases.title: Send an SMS notification
useCases.text: Send one plain SMS from a sender number to one recipient. The text costs money and cannot be recalled, so confirm the wording and number first.

useCases.title: Place an outbound call
useCases.text: Start one outbound call. Plivo rings the number and requests the answer URL, which must return Plivo XML. The call costs money and cannot be recalled.
